name: SLHRM Payslip
html:
{%- set p = payslip_data(doc) -%} {%- set cur = doc.currency -%}

{{ _("Payslip") }} — {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.start_date, "MMMM yyyy") }}

{{ doc.company }}
{{ _("Employee") }}{{ doc.employee_name }} ({{ doc.employee }})
{{ _("Designation") }}{{ doc.designation or "" }}
{{ _("Branch") }}{{ doc.branch or "" }}
{{ _("Period") }}{{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.start_date) }} – {{ frappe.utils.formatdate(doc.end_date) }}
{{ _("Payment Days") }}{{ doc.payment_days }} / {{ doc.total_working_days }}
{%- for l in p.earnings %} {%- endfor %}
{{ _("Earnings") }}{{ _("Amount") }}
{{ l.component }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(l.amount, currency=cur) }}
{{ _("Gross Pay") }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(p.gross, currency=cur) }}
{%- for l in p.deductions %} {%- endfor %}
{{ _("Deductions") }}{{ _("Amount") }}
{{ l.component }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(l.amount, currency=cur) }}
{{ _("Total Deductions") }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(p.total_deduction, currency=cur) }}
{{ _("Net Pay") }}: {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(p.net, currency=cur) }}
{%- if p.employer %}
{%- for l in p.employer %} {%- endfor %}
{{ _("Employer contributions (not deducted)") }}{{ _("Amount") }}
{{ l.component }}{{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(l.amount, currency=cur) }}
{%- endif %}
